title: Proposed 45m Exec Brief + Demo for Tempest — VP/CIO presence?
text:
Proposed 45m Exec Brief + Demo for Tempest — VP/CIO presence?

['From: Samantha Johnson <samantha.johnson@tempest.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Reynolds <mike@tempest.io>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec brief + demo — Tempest x Redwood

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Our CIO (Anjali Rao) and VP Engineering (Devon Park) are interested in a focused executive briefing followed by a short demo of the inference workflow and SLA/commit model. Ideally something that is 30–45 minutes with clear outcomes for procurement/next steps.

Are you / a Redwood exec available next week for a 45m slot? We can do Tue or Thu mornings PT. I attached a short prospect overview and current attendee list for context.

High-level ask:
- 10–15 min executive intro (value / risk posture / enterprise fit)
- 20 min demo (runtime, latency profiles, deployment modes)
- 10 min Q&A & next steps (contracts / pilot scope)

If Vivek isn’t the right exec to lead the briefing, please loop in the appropriate sponsor.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Johnson
Head of Platform Partnerships, Tempest.ai
Attachment: tempest-prospect-intro.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
', 'From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Johnson <samantha.johnson@tempest.io>
Cc: Mike Reynolds <mike@tempest.io>, Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.b@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec brief + demo — Tempest x Redwood

Samantha — thanks for the note and the packet. I can lead the exec intro and cover high level product/SLAs, and we’ll bring a technical lead for the demo segment.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 2028-05-23 09:30–10:15
- Tue 2028-05-23 11:00–11:45
- Thu 2028-05-25 09:00–09:45

Priyom — can you or one of the SEs pick the demo owner (30m deep-dive + runbook), and confirm who will cover a short discussion on quantization/throughput?

Also: would you prefer a more executive-facing agenda (less deep bench-level detail) or a hybrid where we have the first 15 very high-level and then a separate technical follow-up? We can prepare both.

I’ll hold the Tue 11:00 slot tentatively until we have final confirmation. I’ve cc’d Laura to help with calendar logistics and customer materials.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
', 'From: Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.b@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Johnson <samantha.johnson@tempest.io>, Mike Reynolds <mike@tempest.io>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec brief + demo — Tempest x Redwood

Vivek / Laura — I can take the demo ownership. Plan: 20–25 min demo focusing on three things: 1) hosted API and latency SLOs with a small live sample, 2) Dedicated vs Private decision flow with cost/throughput examples, 3) a one-slide runbook for escalation & fallback. I’ll keep the demo light on model internals to remain exec-appropriate.

Backup coverage: Laura, would you be available to cover the SLA + procurement ask if Vivek needs to step out?

I’ll draft a 1-page runbook and mock slide for the agenda. Vivek — should we include a short note on pilot sizing and a proposed SLO in the invite? That usually helps procurement.

— Priyom
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-demo-prep-notes.txt (TXT, 4KB)

On Wed, May 15, 2028 at 10:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Samantha — thanks for the note and the packet. I can lead the exec intro and cover high level product/SLAs, and we’ll bring a technical lead for the demo segment.
>

> - Thu 2028-05-25 09:00–09:45
> 
> Priyom — can you or one of the SEs pick the demo owner (30m deep-dive + runbook), and confirm who will cover a short discussion on quantization/throughput?
> 
> Also: would you prefer a more executive-facing agenda (less deep bench-level detail) or a hybrid where we have the first 15 very high-level and then a separate technical follow-up? We can prepare both.
> 
> I’ll hold the Tue 11:00 slot tentatively until we have final confirmation. I’ve cc’d Laura to help with calendar logistics and customer materials.
', 'From: Samantha Johnson <samantha.johnson@tempest.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Reynolds <mike@tempest.io>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec brief + demo — Tempest x Redwood

All — Tue 11:00 PT works for Anjali and Devon. We prefer the hybrid approach: first 15m executive intro (Vivek), then 25m demo (Priyom), then 5–10m Q&A and next steps.

Attendee notes: Anjali Rao (CIO), Devon Park (VP Eng), myself, Mike Reynolds (Technical Program Manager). I attached the attendee list for the invite.

We’d like you to include a short slide on pilot scope + pricing bands so procurement has something to react to during the call. If you can send that slide 24 hours prior that would be great.

Provisional attendee list attached: tempest-attendee-list.csv (CSV, 6KB)

Thanks — see you Tue 2028-05-23 11:00 PT.
Samantha
', 'From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Johnson <samantha.johnson@tempest.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.b@redwood.ai>, Mike Reynolds <mike@tempest.io>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 19:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec brief + demo — Tempest x Redwood

Great — confirmed Tue 2028-05-23 11:00–11:45 PT (calendar invite sent). We’ll run the hybrid agenda: 15m exec intro (me) + 25m demo (Priyom) + 5–10m Q&A.

Action items (redwood):
- Priyom: demo runbook and one-slide pilot + pricing bands to Samantha by Mon 2028-05-22 11:00 PT.
- Laura: calendar invite + Zoom link and share Drive folder.
- Vivek: attach high-level SLO summary to the invite and be prepared to discuss enterprise onboarding + SLA exceptions.

Backup plan: if Priyom is pulled, Laura will surface the SLA slides and the SE on call will step in.

Runbook / assets will live here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-tempest-demo-resources

Attachments: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

See you next week — Vivek
']
